description.html: The Arcadia 10% UVB T8 fluorescent tube, 15W and 450mm long, is made for desert reptile species that are exposed to strong sunlight in the wild. UVB radiation is essential for vitamin D3 synthesis in reptile skin, which is key to calcium absorption and proper bone development. Without adequate UVB lighting, reptiles can develop metabolic bone disease (MBD).

The high 10% output simulates the intense sunlight of desert and savanna habitats, which is ideal for bearded dragons, uromastyx and other desert species. The T8 tube is installed in a matching fitting (controller) at the top of the terrarium and lights its entire length evenly. Replace the tube every 6-12 months, because UVB output weakens over time even when the visible light stays the same.
